title: NPC
description: A non-player character with an id, name, glyph, spawn tile and an optional patrol route

symbol.description: ASCII character to render this NPC with

spawn.description: Tile where the NPC starts. If patrol is present, must equal the first patrol waypoint.

patrol.description: Optional patrol route. Omit for a stationary NPC.

mode.description: ping_pong (default) paces back and forth; loop returns from the last waypoint to the first

waypoints.description: At least two tile coordinates. Each leg (including last-to-first for loop) must be a straight horizontal or vertical line.

dialogue.description: Optional id of a dialogue (dialogues/*.json) the player talks to this NPC with. Omit for an NPC that cannot be talked to. The loader rejects an id no mod defines.

overrides.description: If present, this NPC overrides another NPC with the same id
